methodology: Independent visual inspection of Blender renders plus actual Blender reopen/export probes. Structural perimeter comparison uses the bottom ring of HARR_Ground_Plinth_Base after subtracting manifest placement origin, compared vertex-to-vertex with the official GIS ring. Structural core bounds are secondary cross-checks, not the footprint measure. No master file was opened or changed.
